lines.sub: Unsold produce is a planning problem.
It decides what ships first, and where.
Twenty six batches, six markets, one day.
Money, spoiled kg, and demand met come first.
Against a strong rule-based dispatcher it ties or gains slightly.
Most perishable first, with a reason each.
If demand is elastic, discounts appear only where they pay.
It replans at once, zero rule breaks.
Thirty bad days, plan and rival fixed: on average about even.
Held out: plus zero to plus point eight percent versus the best rule.
Open assumptions and tested code. This is FreshRoute.
